item.aliveworkplace.keepsake.kitchen.pag:
%1$s's pumpkin pie

One pumpkin, the kind that thuds when you knock on it.
One egg, still warm if you can manage it.
Sugar, and don't be shy with it.

Bake it until the kitchen smells like the end of autumn.

The secret: let it cool on the sill for as long as you can stand to wait, and no longer.

Two are in with this, so you know what to aim for.
request.aliveworkplace.level_up.title: Next level before the festival
request.aliveworkplace.level_up.ask: %2$s, the festival's nearly on us, and I'd dearly love to stand there having made %3$s. Trade with me a while, or spare me a Bottle o' Enchanting. Would you?
request.aliveworkplace.level_up.thanks: %3$s! I made it, %2$s, and I wouldn't have without you. Here, for your trouble.
request.aliveworkplace.home.title: A home of my own
request.aliveworkplace.home.ask: I've a favor to ask, %2$s. I've never had a proper house, with a bed nobody else has a claim on. Would you see one built for me? A fine one, mind, not a hut.
request.aliveworkplace.home.wants: %1$s wants a home of their own (a bed in a finished house of tier II or better)
request.aliveworkplace.home.thanks: I slept like a stone, %2$s. My own roof, my own bed. I won't forget who gave me that.
request.aliveworkplace.taste_of_home.ask: Do you know what I miss, %2$s? The food my people make, where we come from. %3$s, that's all it would take. Could you bring me that?
request.aliveworkplace.taste_of_home.tha: Oh, that's it. That's exactly it. Thank you, %2$s. It tastes like being small again.
request.aliveworkplace.tools_of_my_trade: My gear's worn down to nothing, %2$s. With %3$s I could do this job the way it ought to be done. Could you leave it in the chest by my workstation?
%1$s wants the tools of the trade: %3$s
Now that's a proper tool. You'll see the difference in my work, %2$s, I promise you.
request.aliveworkplace.help_me_train.ask: I'm getting soft, %2$s. Nobody here pushes me. Battle me and beat me, on %3$s different days, and don't you dare go easy.
request.aliveworkplace.help_me_train.wan: %1$s wants a real rival: beat them in battle on %3$s different days
request.aliveworkplace.help_me_train.tha: I've lost more to you than to anyone, %2$s, and learned more from it than from a year of winning. Thank you. Same again some time?
request.aliveworkplace.pokemon_friend.as: The work gets lonely, %2$s. They say a Pokémon makes all the difference, and one of the %3$s type would suit my trade. If one were pastured near my workstation, I think we'd get on.
request.aliveworkplace.pokemon_friend.wa: %1$s wants a Pokémon friend at work (%3$s type, pastured within 16 blocks of their workstation at dawn)
request.aliveworkplace.pokemon_friend.th: Did you see who was waiting for me this morning, %2$s? We're going to be great friends. Thank you.
%2$s, would you carry a letter for me? It's to my %3$s. We haven't seen each other in years, and a caravan's no way to send something like this.
%1$s wants a letter carried to their %3$s, and the reply brought back
They wrote back! And so much news, %2$s. Thank you for carrying it all that way, both ways.
request.aliveworkplace.bring_back_my_lov: I can't stop going to the graveyard, %2$s. %3$s lies there, and they say an Undertaker can bring the dead back, with a golden apple, a healing potion or a totem. Would you see it done?
%2$s, they're back. They're really back. We're getting married all over again, and you're coming.
request.aliveworkplace.cat_by_the_door.a: It's too quiet at home, %2$s. What I'd give for %3$s by my door when I wake. Could you find me one?
request.aliveworkplace.cat_by_the_door.w: %1$s wants %3$s by their bed at dawn
request.aliveworkplace.cat_by_the_door.t: There it was this morning, waiting by the door like it had always lived there. Thank you, %2$s.
request.aliveworkplace.off_to_school.ask: My little %3$s has never been to school, %2$s, and I want better for them than I had. The village needs a Teacher. Could you see to it?
request.aliveworkplace.off_to_school.wan: %1$s wants their child %3$s to go to school
request.aliveworkplace.off_to_school.tha: %3$s came home reading, %2$s! Reading! I'll never be able to thank you enough.
request.aliveworkplace.chapel_wedding.as: %2$s, I'm to be married, and I've always dreamed of a wedding in a %3$s. We have none here. If one were built, we'd wait for it. Would you help?
%2$s, I'm to be married, and I've always dreamed of a wedding in an %3$s. We have none here. If one were built, we'd wait for it. Would you help?
request.aliveworkplace.chapel_wedding.wa: %1$s wants a %3$s built for their wedding
%1$s wants an %3$s built for their wedding
request.aliveworkplace.chapel_wedding.th: Married in the %3$s, with the whole village at the feast. It was everything I dreamed of, %2$s.
request.aliveworkplace.lost_heirloom.ask: %2$s, my family had %3$s for generations, and it was lost, far from here. I've a map of the place. Would you look for it?
request.aliveworkplace.lost_heirloom.tha: %3$s! I never thought I'd hold it again. Thank you, %2$s, from all of us, the living and the gone.
request.aliveworkplace.letter.read: A letter from %1$s! It's been so long. Wait here, %2$s, I'll write back at once. Take this to them, would you?
request.aliveworkplace.letter.again: Lost it, %1$s? Never mind, I'll write it out again. Here.
request.aliveworkplace.letter.reply_agai: My reply went astray, %1$s? Here, I'll write it out again.
request.aliveworkplace.heirloom.diary.pa: My dear %s, if you are reading this you have found my diary, and I am long gone. I was the first of our family to leave the old village. I walked for nine days with nothing but this book and a loaf of bread.
On the tenth day I came to a valley with a river in it, and a man mending a fence who asked if I could hold the other end. I held it for forty years. That is how our family came to be.
Keep the fences mended, keep the bread rising, and when somebody asks you to hold the other end, hold it. Your loving great-aunt.

arc.aliveworkplace.bandit_king.1.intro.1: Smoke rises from three hills round the village: three bandit camps went up in a night.
arc.aliveworkplace.bandit_king.1.intro.2: Their chiefs call themselves Captains of the Bandit King, and every camp flies his war banner. Take the three banners.
arc.aliveworkplace.bandit_king.2.intro.1: With his banners lost, the Bandit King comes himself. Out past the hills his men raise a fort, a stage every dawn.
arc.aliveworkplace.bandit_king.2.intro.2: Win allies before his keep stands: a neighboring village's pledge, swords for hire at the hall, or the deserter waiting by the ashes of the first camp.
arc.aliveworkplace.bandit_king.3.intro.1: The keep stands. Raise a Rally Banner near the fort and your guards and allies will follow you in.
arc.aliveworkplace.bandit_king.3.intro.2: Until the King falls his raiders come every second night, and if he still stands in ten days he will take his tribute.
arc.aliveworkplace.bandit_king.pell_says: The King's keep has a postern at the back. I'll see it's left open. Then I'm done with him.

A dry gray cough is going round the village, and nothing the village's healer has eases more than the slowness of it.
It passes from one villager to the next at night. Talk to the village's healer: right-click them.
Only a tonic of three far herbs will end the Gray Cough, and none of them grows near the village.
Follow the healer's maps to the herb patches and bring back 3 of each.
The healer brews the Three-Herb Tonic over half a day, then takes it round to everyone who coughs.
arc.aliveworkplace.the_sickness.healer_t: The Gray Cough. My remedies only ease it for a day. There's an old tonic of three far herbs that ends it: let me look out where they grow.

arc.aliveworkplace.professors_thesis.1.i: The professor is writing a thesis and needs field notes no book can give: three Pokémon, caught where and when the theory says they should be.
Catch them and the professor will write down every one.
arc.aliveworkplace.professors_thesis.2.i: The notes are good, but the professor wants to see how a Pokémon grows. Show them one of your catches evolved, or any Pokémon that trusts you completely.
arc.aliveworkplace.professors_thesis.3.i: No thesis is published until someone tries to tear it apart. A strong trainer has to test the ideas in battle.
arc.aliveworkplace.professors_thesis.req: I'm writing my thesis on %s. Will you help me with the field work?
arc.aliveworkplace.professors_thesis.sho: Not quite. Show me one of the Pokémon you caught for me after it has evolved, or one with friendship of %s or more.
Remarkable! That's exactly what the thesis needs. Thank you.
arc.aliveworkplace.professors_thesis.the: I am Thessaly, and I've read your professor's draft. Beat me in battle and I'll admit it holds up.
Fine. The thesis stands. I'll say so in my review.

aliveworkplace.config.wellKeepers.toolti: Sneak-right-click a villager by a cauldron with a shovel and they carry water to the fields in a drought, and keep the cauldrons full and the farmland wet between droughts. Off: no Well Keeper job, and Well Keepers already hired stand idle.
aliveworkplace.config.denHelpers.tooltip: Hire the village's trainers from the hall's Defense page to help in a raid at a den the village knows: they follow you, cheer you on once a raid with a cheer item each, and their Pokémon wear the boss down. Needs Cobblemon Raid Dens. Off: no hiring, and those hired walk home.
aliveworkplace.config.denHelperPrice.too: How many emeralds one raid helper costs.
aliveworkplace.config.villageMegas.toolt: A City's Trainer Leaders, the Festival Cup's finalists and the Stadium Day's visitors carry a Mega Stone too, and every trainer who can Mega Evolve wears a Mega Bracelet. The Jeweler cuts Mega Stones and Key Stones, and beating every Trainer Leader of a realm earns a Mega Bracelet. Needs Mega Showdown. Off: only Masters Mega Evolve, nobody wears a bracelet and the village makes no Mega Stones.
aliveworkplace.config.cuisineDishes.tool: The Chef cooks the Cobblecuisine dishes players ask for on the hall board's Dishes tab (once the village has a Chef), from their own recipes (salads and sandwiches from the start, drinks at Apprentice, curries at Journeyman, cakes at Expert), each counts as its own kind of food for the villagers' diet, the Camp Cook adds its curries and the Innkeeper serves its drinks. Partner Pokémon get a Poké Puff or shake from the store once a day as their treat, Burghers want a Deluxe Shake every 4 days and Nobles a Clodsire Eclair every 8. Needs Cobblecuisine. With Cobblemon alone, the Chef also cooks every Campfire Pot recipe (the EXP and IV/EV candies, medicines, sweets) when the store holds its makings. Off: the menus are as they were, with no treats, dish luxuries or candies.
aliveworkplace.config.beanFarms.tooltip: Farmers sow Cobblecuisine's beans on their fields when the store holds fewer than 16 of a color a dish on the menu needs, and harvest them when fully grown, into the store. Needs Cobblecuisine. Off: farmers never sow beans.
aliveworkplace.config.furnicrafters.tool: With CobbleFurnies installed, a jobless villager by its Furni Crafter becomes the village's Furnicrafter, who makes the CobbleFurnies furniture the builders are waiting for (a furnished home's chairs, tables and lamps) and the storehouse's stock orders ask for, from the store's materials. Off: no new Furnicrafters, and those hired stand idle.

aliveworkplace.config.mechanics.tooltip: With Create installed, a jobless villager by a Create Toolbox becomes the village's Mechanic: they empty the village's Create machines into the store, refill them, and put back shafts, cogwheels and belts missing from finished builds. Off: no Mechanic job, and Mechanics already hired stand idle.
aliveworkplace.config.machineWork.toolti: With Create installed, villagers work Create's machines: the farmer mills wheat into flour, the armorer presses ingots into sheets, the chef mixes dough and the miner crushes raw ore. They take what goes in from the store and bring back what's made, only while the machine turns and the store has room. Off: nobody feeds a machine.
aliveworkplace.config.createBuilds.toolt: With Create installed, the Blueprint Table offers the Watermill, the Windmill, the Workshop, the Brass Foundry, the Sawmill, the Crushing Mill, the Greenhouse, the Clock Tower and the Pump House, workplaces whose machines turn as soon as the builder is done, and builders put a blueprint's moving parts in last, in order, and check they turn. Off: these aren't offered and builds go up layer by layer (builds already started still finish).
aliveworkplace.config.createSchematics.t: With Create installed, the Blueprint Table lists the schematics players uploaded with Create's Schematic Table, and a written Schematic used on the table imports its file. Off: the table leaves Create's schematics alone (those already imported stay).
aliveworkplace.config.villageTrains.tool: With Create installed, the Blueprint Table offers the Train Station. Two villages with a caravan route and a station each get Create track laid along the road between them by their builders, and their caravans go by train: a third of the trip, and never lost. A jobless villager by a Train Station becomes the village's Conductor, who drives its train and calls its stops. Off: no station at the table, no track laid, no new Conductors, and caravans walk (a train already on its way still comes in).

arc.aliveworkplace.shift_bell.1.intro.1: The long shifts wear on the smithy. The Toolsmith wipes their brow and waves you over.
chatter.aliveworkplace.shift_bell.1: My arms ache. A bell to tell us when to stop, that's all I ask.
arc.aliveworkplace.shift_bell.2.intro.1: A clock or two, they say, and nobody would work past the hour. Clocks first.
chatter.aliveworkplace.shift_bell.2: Two dozen clocks! Now we'll know the hour.
arc.aliveworkplace.shift_bell.3.intro.1: Clocks tick in every workshop now. A bell needs gold for its voice.
chatter.aliveworkplace.shift_bell.3: Gold for the bell's voice. It'll ring sweet.
arc.aliveworkplace.shift_bell.4.intro.1: The bell is cast. Only the workers' supper is left to pay for: bread, and plenty of it.
chatter.aliveworkplace.shift_bell.4: Bread for the bell-raising. We'll all eat together.
arc.aliveworkplace.shift_bell.ask: Ask the smith about the long shifts
arc.aliveworkplace.shift_bell.says: "We hammer from dawn to dark and nobody knows when the day ends. Give us a bell to ring the work in and out, and we'll keep the long shifts gladly."
chronicle.aliveworkplace.shift_bell.endi: The Shift Bell stands by the hall. It rings the work day in and out, and the long shifts have lost their sting.
arc.aliveworkplace.common_granary.1.intr: The bread is free, but the fields can't keep up. A Farmer stops you at the hall's door.
chatter.aliveworkplace.common_granary.1: Free bread, empty fields. It can't last.
arc.aliveworkplace.common_granary.2.intr: A common granary needs grain to fill it. Wheat, and lots of it.
chatter.aliveworkplace.common_granary.2: The wheat's coming in. Look at it all!
arc.aliveworkplace.common_granary.3.intr: Grain keeps best baled. Hay for the granary's lofts.
chatter.aliveworkplace.common_granary.3: Hay bales stacked to the rafters. A good sight.
arc.aliveworkplace.common_granary.4.intr: The granary needs barrels to keep the flour dry.
chatter.aliveworkplace.common_granary.4: Barrels for the flour. The granary's nearly done.
arc.aliveworkplace.common_granary.ask: Hear the farmer out about the bread
arc.aliveworkplace.common_granary.says: "Free bread is a fine thing, but we bake it from seed corn. Help us fill a common granary, and nobody will go hungry to feed the rest."
The Common Granary is full. Tomorrow evening the village sits down to a harvest supper at the hall.
arc.aliveworkplace.midwives.1.intro.1: Cradles fill faster than anyone can mind them. The Nurse looks tired and asks for a word.
chatter.aliveworkplace.midwives.1: Another baby on the way! I'll need help.
arc.aliveworkplace.midwives.2.intro.1: Mothers need strength. Honey for the new mothers.
chatter.aliveworkplace.midwives.2: Honey for the mothers. They've earned it.
arc.aliveworkplace.midwives.3.intro.1: Babies need warm blankets. Wool, and a lot of it.
arc.aliveworkplace.midwives.4.intro.1: Golden carrots keep the little ones healthy.
chatter.aliveworkplace.midwives.4: Golden carrots for the little ones. A midwife is on her way, I hear.
arc.aliveworkplace.midwives.ask: Talk to the nurse about the families
arc.aliveworkplace.midwives.says: "Big families are a blessing, but I can't be at every cradle. Help me set up a proper lying-in, and send word for a midwife."
chronicle.aliveworkplace.midwives.ending: A midwife has come to stay. The families grow, and every cradle is minded.
arc.aliveworkplace.watchful_gate.1.intro: With the gates open, strangers come and go at all hours. A Guard asks you to help keep watch.
chatter.aliveworkplace.watchful_gate.1: Too many faces at the gate. Who are they all?
arc.aliveworkplace.watchful_gate.2.intro: Iron for the gate's bars and the watch's gear.
chatter.aliveworkplace.watchful_gate.2: Iron! The smith will make good bars of it.
arc.aliveworkplace.watchful_gate.3.intro: Arrows for the watch on the walls.
chatter.aliveworkplace.watchful_gate.3: Arrows on the walls. Let them come.
arc.aliveworkplace.watchful_gate.4.intro: Clear the roads of the monsters that slip in at night.
chatter.aliveworkplace.watchful_gate.4: The roads are clearer. An old friend of mine is on his way.
arc.aliveworkplace.watchful_gate.ask: Hear the guard's worry about the gates
arc.aliveworkplace.watchful_gate.says: "Open gates bring trade, and trouble. Help me arm the watch, and I know an old soldier who'd come to keep it."
chronicle.aliveworkplace.watchful_gate.e: An old soldier has come to the gate, in iron. Open gates, and a watchful one.
arc.aliveworkplace.festival_fund.1.intro: Festival after festival, and the purse is thin. The Bard asks if you'd help start a fund.
arc.aliveworkplace.festival_fund.2.intro: Every festival needs cake. A fund for cakes.
chatter.aliveworkplace.festival_fund.2: Cakes in the store! I could sing.
arc.aliveworkplace.festival_fund.3.intro: Fireworks, and plenty of them, set by for the next one.
chatter.aliveworkplace.festival_fund.3: Fireworks enough for a grand night.
arc.aliveworkplace.festival_fund.4.intro: Note blocks for a band worth hearing.
chatter.aliveworkplace.festival_fund.4: Note blocks! The band will be the talk of the land.
arc.aliveworkplace.festival_fund.ask: Talk to the bard about the festival fund
arc.aliveworkplace.festival_fund.says: "The festivals are the best thing in this village, but the treasury pays for every one. Help me fill a festival fund, and the next one will be grand."
chronicle.aliveworkplace.festival_fund.e: The Festival Fund is full. The next festival will be a grand one.
arc.aliveworkplace.fair_ledger.1.intro.1: The tithe goes in and nobody sees where it goes. A Librarian asks to keep the books.
chatter.aliveworkplace.fair_ledger.1: Where does the tithe go? Nobody knows.
arc.aliveworkplace.fair_ledger.2.intro.1: A ledger needs books to write in.
chatter.aliveworkplace.fair_ledger.2: Books to write in. Now we can keep count.
arc.aliveworkplace.fair_ledger.3.intro.1: Gold, to show the treasury is good for it.
chatter.aliveworkplace.fair_ledger.3: Gold in the strongroom, written down.
arc.aliveworkplace.fair_ledger.4.intro.1: A ledger needs a keeper who can stand up for it.
arc.aliveworkplace.fair_ledger.ask: Ask the librarian about the tithe
arc.aliveworkplace.fair_ledger.says: "Everyone pays the tithe and nobody knows what it buys. Let me keep a fair ledger, day by day, and people will pay it without grumbling."
chronicle.aliveworkplace.fair_ledger.end: The Fair Ledger is written. The tithe is kept in the open, day by day.
The curfew empties the streets at dusk. A Porter asks if lamps could light them instead.
chatter.aliveworkplace.lamplighters.1: Dark streets. I hurry home every night.
chatter.aliveworkplace.lamplighters.2: Lanterns! The corners won't be dark.
Clear the dark of what prowls in it.
chatter.aliveworkplace.lamplighters.4: The streets are safe. Soon they'll be lit.
arc.aliveworkplace.lamplighters.ask: Talk to the porter about the curfew
arc.aliveworkplace.lamplighters.says: "The curfew keeps us in because the streets are dark. Light them, and we'll walk home safe without one."
chronicle.aliveworkplace.lamplighters.en: The Lamplighters have lit the streets. Two Street Lamp blueprints were given to raise more.
arc.aliveworkplace.militia_drill.1.intro: Conscripts drop their tools whenever a raid comes. A Guard asks to train them properly.
chatter.aliveworkplace.militia_drill.1: They drop their hoes and run at the first horn.
arc.aliveworkplace.militia_drill.4.intro: Real practice: clear out the monsters round the village.
chatter.aliveworkplace.militia_drill.4: They fought well out there. Time for a proper drill.
arc.aliveworkplace.militia_drill.ask: Talk to the guard about the conscripts
arc.aliveworkplace.militia_drill.says: "Drafted folk with no training are no help in a fight. Arm them and drill them, and the work won't stop when trouble comes."
chronicle.aliveworkplace.militia_drill.e: The militia is trained. Tomorrow at noon the village drills at the Training Dummies.
chronicle.aliveworkplace.reform_story.sh: The Shift Bell was raised beside the hall of %s.
chronicle.aliveworkplace.reform_story.ha: %s will hold a harvest supper at the hall tomorrow evening.
chronicle.aliveworkplace.reform_story.mi: %s came to %s as a midwife and took up as its Nurse.
chronicle.aliveworkplace.reform_story.ol: %s, an old soldier in iron, came to keep the gate of %s.

chronicle.aliveworkplace.reform_story.fa: The Fair Ledger of %s was written and given to the hall's keeper.
chronicle.aliveworkplace.reform_story.la: The first lamplit night in %s: the streets glowed, and nobody hurried home.

wonder.aliveworkplace.great_cathedral.de: A Gothic cathedral on a cross plan: two west towers under stone spires, a rose window over a deep west door, flying buttresses along the nave. Undertakers bring the village's dead back by morning, weddings held there are blessed, and the whole village is the more beautiful for it.
wonder.aliveworkplace.great_cathedral.st: The Foundations and the West Front
The Towers and the Rose Window
wonder.aliveworkplace.lighthouse.name: Lighthouse
wonder.aliveworkplace.lighthouse.descrip: A tower banded in white and red on a stepped stone mole, its lantern lit by night, with the keeper's cottage, a boathouse, a quay and a jetty to the ferry at its foot. Caravans go twice as far in half the time, ferry fares are halved, and the village is warned a day before raiders come from the sea.
wonder.aliveworkplace.lighthouse.stage.4: The Lantern and the Keeper's House
wonder.aliveworkplace.great_library.name: Great Library
wonder.aliveworkplace.great_library.desc: A domed library on a cross plan: a rotunda of bookshelf galleries under a copper dome, four wings of reading halls and a portico of six quartz columns. The village's scholars open a second tier of research.
wonder.aliveworkplace.observatory.name: Observatory
wonder.aliveworkplace.observatory.descri: A round tower under a copper dome on a raised terrace, its great telescope leaning out of a slit of tinted glass, with a star-chart room, a sundial and an orrery in the courtyard. The Seer charts the land for three thousand blocks around and reads the coming days.
The Great Telescope and the Orrery
wonder.aliveworkplace.stadium.name: Stadium
wonder.aliveworkplace.stadium.descriptio: An oval arena of stone round a grass battle field, with stands of red and white seats, trainer boxes and a professor's box, a covered stand, a gateway arch, a scoreboard and floodlights that light up at night. Under the stands you can walk a lit concourse, the dressing rooms, the players' tunnel, food kiosks and a first-aid room. Every second afternoon visiting trainers come to battle, and the Festival Cup is held here.
wonder.aliveworkplace.stadium.stage.3: The Upper Stands and the Covered Stand
edict.aliveworkplace.royal_highway.desc: The crown keeps the roads between its villages: caravans between members carry more and arrive sooner, and the realm treasury pays for every route.
reform.aliveworkplace.paved_highway.line: Stone roads keep themselves: the caravans stay quick and the treasury pays no more upkeep.
edict.aliveworkplace.common_market.desc: One board for the whole realm: every member pays the members' average price, and the realm's people trade without the spread. The levy rises to pay for it.
reform.aliveworkplace.weights_and_measur: One measure in every market: the common board stays and the levy goes back down.
edict.aliveworkplace.levy_of_arms.desc: Every member sends relief to a raided member, wherever it is, in bands twice as big; each member pays dues into the realm treasury.
reform.aliveworkplace.armed_levy.line: The levy keeps its own arms: the bands still ride and no member pays dues.
edict.aliveworkplace.realm_festival.desc: Every member holds its festival on the capital's day, and the good mood lasts three days; the realm treasury pays a share of each.
reform.aliveworkplace.square_lanterns.li: The lanterns hang all year: the realm still feasts together, and the treasury pays nothing more.
edict.aliveworkplace.crowns_peace.desc: No feud may be declared on a member and bandits never camp near one; the crown's peace costs every member a tenth of its takings.
reform.aliveworkplace.cleared_roads.line: The roads are safe of themselves: the peace holds and the takings are whole again.
edict.aliveworkplace.royal_charter.desc: Members found colonies from Town rank and wait half as long between them; each colony costs the realm treasury 32 emeralds more.
reform.aliveworkplace.drafted_charter.li: The charter is written down for good: colonies still come early and quickly, and cost the realm nothing more.

wonder.aliveworkplace.great_wall.name: Great Wall
wonder.aliveworkplace.great_wall.descrip: A curtain of stone 97 long and 12 high on a battered plinth, with a crenellated walk, four towers and the Great Gate, its portcullis over a gate of fence gates. No raid gathers behind it, and iron golem sentries keep its walk.
wonder.aliveworkplace.great_wall.stage.4: The Walk and the Towers' Crowns
wonder.aliveworkplace.hanging_gardens.de: A garden mountain of four sandstone terraces, each faced with arcades hung with vines and glow berries and topped with fields, berry beds, flowers, hives and trees. A cistern on the crown pours a waterfall down its side into a pool, and a ramp spirals to the top. Farmers and orchard keepers across the realm harvest more, and the village grows faster.
wonder.aliveworkplace.hanging_gardens.st: The First Terrace and the Cistern Vaults
The Crown Garden and the Falls
wonder.aliveworkplace.colossus.name: Colossus
wonder.aliveworkplace.colossus.descripti: The Founder's statue, a robed villager in stone under a copper cloak that weathers green, one hand on the chest and the other holding up a lantern lit day and night. It stands on a stepped plinth ringed with braziers, over an arch the main road and its caravans pass through. The whole realm is happier, and more travelers come, more of them Experts.
wonder.aliveworkplace.colossus.stage.1: The Plinth and the Road Arch
aliveworkplace.config.wonderStanding.too: How much of a finished Wonder must still stand for its powers. Under it, its powers stop and the village's builders repair it.
aliveworkplace.config.furnishedBuilds.to: Builders use the furniture mods you have installed (Handcrafted, Lucky's Cozy Home, CobbleFurnies, Beautify) for chairs, tables, beds, lamps and blinds. Off: every build is the plain vanilla build.
aliveworkplace.config.moddedStorageNetwo: A Sophisticated Storage controller or a Tom's Simple Storage connector in the Storehouse counts as one store for every chest it links. Off: each linked chest is its own store.
aliveworkplace.config.moddedLibrary.tool: Homes and workshops are built from the modded library: the same builds dressed with Rechiseled, Supplementaries, Carved Wood, Chipped and Handcrafted blocks, when all of those mods are installed and Furnished Builds is on. Off, or a mod missing: the vanilla builds.
